learnings.text: CLI command is 'tk' to avoid collisions
Using flock for file locking (works on macOS/Linux)
JSON chosen over YAML for faster parsing and less ambiguity
MCP server will use stdio mode for Claude Code integration
taskResult type in MCP server is local - use JSON marshal/unmarshal for testing

decisions.because: Single binary, good concurrency, fast startup for CLI
Faster parsing, unambiguous, better for programmatic access
Best for token efficiency - workers get scoped context
Single responsibility - Tasuku manages tasks, Grove manages worktrees. Avoids duplication and leverages existing Grove infrastructure.
Tasuku is local-first with JSON file. Server-dependent features don't fit the philosophy. Focus on agent coordination, tags, time tracking, custom fields.

grove-integration.text: Approach: Auto-detect Grove availability. If Grove present, use grove_new for full experience (worktree + dev server). If not, fall back to native git worktree commands for basic isolation. Print tip about Grove for full experience.
Detection: Check if Grove MCP is configured in Claude settings or attempt grove_list call. Native fallback uses git worktree add ../tasuku-{task-id} -b {task-id}

v2-agent-coordination.text: Commands: tk task claim <id>, tk task release <id>, tk task who. Use owner field + timestamps. Consider lock timeout for stale claims.

v2-gh-pr.text: Simple wrapper: gh pr create --title <desc> --body <notes>. Check gh is installed. Auto-detect current branch task ID from branch name.

v2-tags-labels.text: Add Tags []string to Task struct. Commands: tk task add --tag x,y, tk task list --tag x, tk task tag <id> add/remove <tag>. Consider tag autocomplete.

v2-time-tracking.text: Add TimeEntries []TimeEntry to Task. Commands: tk task time start/stop/show <id>. Calculate total duration. Consider Pomodoro-style features.
